# FLOID

> Free design process scheduling software for industrial designers and product development teams.

FLOID is a browser-based timeline scheduling tool purpose-built for industrial designers. It helps teams plan and visualize product development timelines using drag-and-drop phases, tasks, and milestones.

## Key Details

- Website: https://floid.design/
- Pricing: Free
- Platform: Web browser (no install required)
- Category: Project scheduling, timeline management, product development planning

## What FLOID Does

FLOID lets you create project timelines with multiple schedule tracks (called sections). Each section contains phases, tasks, and milestones arranged on a visual timeline. A master schedule drives the overall project dates, and other sections can be locked to sync with it or run independently.

## Core Features

- Drag-and-drop timeline scheduling
- Master schedule sync with locked and independent binding modes
- Phases, tasks, and milestone tracking
- Multiple schedule sections per project
- Color-coded schedule rows
- Export as .floid file, full project backup, or timeline image
- Dark mode
- Keyboard shortcuts
- No account required

## Who It's For

- Industrial designers planning product development timelines
- Product development teams managing multi-track schedules
- Design managers coordinating parallel workstreams
- Anyone who needs a free, visual timeline scheduling tool
